message: 乙女の園

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, I'm counting on you. Well then!」
I leave my notebook of exam predictions with the dorm mother and step out of the manager's office. I wanted to hand it straight to Azel, but apparently she's out.
...It's not like she asked me to do it, so it can't be helped.
Still, I want to do at least this much for a classmate who just transferred in and is about to face her very first exam.

name: Misa
message: 「Hehehe...」
I turn away from the dorm entrance, and after walking just a short distance, I unexpectedly run into Misa.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I want to tour it right now, though... No, let's wait until after the exams. I'm sure it'll be much more brimming with the signs of daily life then...」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun, how long have you been--!」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr! You're trying to distract me so I won't score well on the exams, aren't you!? I won't lose to such underhanded sabotage!!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, I just happened to be passing by... I have no idea what you're talking about?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahem! I'm simply taking a stroll as a break from studying for exams. Moderate rest and exercise are essential for using one's brain efficiently, you know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah!? You're doing the same thing, aren't you! Very well, I accept your strolling challenge! Bring it on!」

name: Synn
message: 「...By what criteria are we supposed to decide the winner of that?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're wondering why I stopped to gaze at the dormitory while out on my stroll, aren't you? Yes, it's only natural that you would think that, Sakura-kun.」

name: Misa
message: 「See? This is quite a lovely building, isn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-She totally ignored the question and started babbling about stuff nobody even asked about!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I actually want to hear it. After all, it's a girls' dorm where boys aren't allowed.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ufufu... Just looking at it brings to mind scenes of the dorm girls gathering every day to recite poetry, doesn't it?」
R-Really? Would it?

name: Misa
message: 「And it wouldn't be strange at all if they held a tea party in Mrs. Smith's room every Sunday.」
...Who's Mrs. Smith? Why would a married woman be a student at Ryuusei Academy?

name: Misa
message: 「However, it seems that hasn't been the case lately. Apparently, it's far more lived-in than I imagined.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, that doesn't change the fact that it's still beautiful♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, sounds nice. Dorm life.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's still just a rumor, though... I heard they might build a boys' dorm in a few years.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat!? O-Of course the boys and girls would live on separate floors, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Obviously. There's no way they'd live in the same rooms!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still... if that happens, it won't be able to stay a girls' dorm like it is now.」

name: Misa
message: 「One of the dorm residents told me it has a sacred sort of comfort to it.」

name: Misa
message: 「I want to see it one more time before that charm disappears... Hehe, it'll be something to look forward to once exams are over.」

name: Synn
message: 「Must be nice. Even if I wanted to go inside, I'm not allowed.」

name: Misa
message: 「It will probably remain a girls' dorm while I'm still a student, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「What kind of events would unfold once boys move in for the first time? It's fun to imagine.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, the heroine will be a girl living in the dorm... Now, how should I place the rivals, the dorm mother, and the supporting characters...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「The boy she admires becomes a dorm resident... Yes. The boys would definitely be on the first floor...」

name: Misa
message: 「An event where he misunderstands something, tries a little night visit, and gets counterattacked by the heroine is a must... The problem is the plot after that...」
Muttering happily to herself, Misa walks away toward the back of the student dormitory.
For Misa, her reward to herself after exams must be getting a tour inside the girls' dorm.
In contrast, exams were the only thing on my mind. If I'm going to bother anyway, I want to give myself something to look forward to like Misa does.
Thinking over various things, I walk away as well.
